order_method: All six A slots first in fixed shuffled order. B/C/D then use all six permutations, each arm twice in every position. One independent initial thread per slot; only eligible correction resumes its own Luna.
reveal: No additional probes in any initial worker input. Freeze initial candidate before B/C/D receive public check evidence. Hidden scripts, controls and grades are never worker/Sol inputs.
budget: All four arms get 1200 total seconds including checks, diagnosis, one correction, isolation, snapshot capture and grading. A may use up to 1000 for ordinary self-testing. B/C/D have the same 600 initial and 180 correction limits; D alone spends up to 120 of the same total on qualified Sol diagnosis.
trigger: Public probe 0 must fail with intact native AssertionError evidence on the exact candidate. All selected checks must be available. Missing tools, environment errors, private grades, self-authored expectations, reviewer claims and green probes never authorize repair.
Sol: Zero dispatches on green or unqualified checks. Full original request, frozen candidate and public receipt-bound evidence only. No earlier plan or private grade. Advice never authorizes correction.
stop: Stop on native access/isolation failure, input/runtime drift, unavailable selected checks or hidden grading, total-budget exhaustion or uncertain interrupted dispatch. Keep all slots. Never retry, substitute model/reasoning, replay, force completion or expand tasks.
controls: 24 controls: reference, alternative, public-probe defect, and green-probe hidden defect per task. Original repository tests must be green for every control. Fresh native controls and B/C assertion-equivalence qualification are zero-model. Reuse #32 staged same-thread control as machinery evidence only, not natural recovery.
corpus: Six fresh representative synthetic Python repositories, five multi-file changes; not a random real-world sample. Literal public and disjoint hidden assertions derived from each original task request before any worker. Single author; alternatives share validation and are not independent human oracle replication.
costs: Full elapsed times, stage/model usage, session-delta tokens, uncached=input-cached, tools, public setup/qualification/execution, grader time and failed slots. Billing, authoring tokens/dollars and active human time unknown unless independently observed. Checks are not free. No hypothetical dollars represented as billing.
authorization: Fresh explicit user authorization bound to FREEZE.json is required before execute. Issue #32 approval is inapplicable. PR creation is authorized by the current request; merge is not.
